subject: executor: fix the issue that spill files may not be completely deleted when `Out Of Quota For Local Temporary Space` is triggered (#63222)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent focusing on executor spill cleanup paths. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL/runtime semantics, concurrency, or resource lifecycle for the touched executor code.
